0.26.1.summary: Pick your update track, and a guided first run

highlights.title: Stable or Preview updates
highlights.body: Choose a release track in General settings. Switching tracks cancels any download from the old one.

highlights.title: A guided first run
highlights.body: Set up agents, sign in, add MCP servers and bring over chats from other apps in one pass.

highlights.title: The zuse command
highlights.body: A standalone terminal command now ships next to the desktop downloads.

0.26.0-preview.5.summary: Favorites in the model picker, and search from the address bar

highlights.title: Favorite models
highlights.body: Keep the models you use at the top of the picker. Reasoning, Fast mode and context live in their own menu.

highlights.title: Search from the address bar
highlights.body: Type a query in the browser bar. The home page shows local previews and recent pages.

highlights.title: Mermaid in pull requests
highlights.body: Diagrams render in pull request descriptions and comments.
